commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Ashad ({1}{U}{B}{R} 3/3 legendary artifact Cyberman) gives the first nonlegendary artifact spell each turn casualty 2. Sacrificing a power-2+ creature copies that spell, the copy becomes a token (not cast, not 'created'), and every other creature sacrificed grows Ashad. Shimmer Myr and flash artifacts make 'each turn' include opponents' turns. Twinning Staff adds a copy and Biotransference turns creature spells into artifact spells. Value comes from copying ETB artifacts (Wurmcoil, Solemn, Noxious Gearhulk, Portal) and converting sacrifices with altars, KCI, Plunderer, Mayhem Devil and Disciple. The plan is gated by having a power-2+ body before the first artifact spell.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 - Optimized artifact factory: three Game Changers (Cyclonic Rift, Demonic Tutor, Fierce Guardianship), the Spellbook Urza + Worldwalker Helm + Artificer Class line, and (candidate) the conditional Razorlash + Pitiless Plunderer + Phyrexian Altar loop. Only 30 lands, and it is fragile to artifact hate. Not cEDH.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Every add is a nonlegendary artifact that either pays casualty 2 (Piggy Bank, Razorlash, Royal Warden + tokens), makes the copy matter (Necron Deathmark), or turns sacrifices into cards (Skullclamp). Missy, Davros and Cult of Skaro-style legendary payoffs were rejected because they are separate encyclopedia commanders and Ashad can't copy legendaries.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All 99 reviewed by quantity (95 rows, 100 physical): 30 lands (22 nonbasic incl. 3 artifact lands and Urza's Saga, plus 3 Island, 2 Mountain, 3 Swamp), 9 static rocks, 4 cost reducers/Class, 41 nonland artifacts (37 nonlegendary), and 17 creatures with power 2+. Overlap: nine rocks for avg nonland MV 3.41. The weak point is fodder: Disciple, Welder, Emry, Padeem, Plunderer, Urza, Fireweaver, Sculptor, Strix and Marionette are all 1-power bodies, and Thopter Spy Network makes 1/1s that can't pay casualty 2.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Baseline: 30 lands + 9 rocks = 39 static sources, avg nonland MV 3.41. Candidate: 30 lands + 8 rocks = 38 (Fellwar Stone cut), avg nonland MV 3.35, plus Piggy Bank/Plunderer Treasures and four reducers. Curve by MV 0/1/2/3/4/5/6+: 1/3/19/21/11/2/12 -> 1/4/19/21/10/3/11 (printed MV; Thoughtcast and Thought Monitor count at full MV). Colored land sources U/B/R are unchanged at 18/16/14, counting fetches and Exotic Orchard (17/16/14 without Orchard, matching the repo mana_base record). Nonland pips U/B/R go from 35/16/13 to 32/18/13 (Deathmark and Warden BB, plus Razorlash BB to return). Honest cost: P(at least 4 lands-or-rocks in the top 10 cards, i.e. Ashad on turn 4 on the draw) falls from 0.610 to 0.583, and black demand rises against 16 black land sources
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Arcane Denial, Mana Drain, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat. Removal: Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Cyber Conversion, Noxious Gearhulk, Delete, Their Name Is Death, Portal to Phyrexia, plus Necron Deathmark (new, flash, copyable). Protection: Lightning Greaves, Padeem. Graveyard: recursion via Emry, Welder, Scrap Trawler, Academy Ruins and Razorlash; graveyard hate stops Razorlash and the welders. Commander-removed state: Skullclamp, Royal Warden and Deathmark all work without Ashad.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Ashad page (artifact section); live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: Repeatable card draw and casualty enabler: equip {1}, +1/-1, draw two when the equipped creature dies
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses the ninth static mana rock (Fellwar Stone only makes colors opponents' lands can make). Static sources go from 39 to 38: 30 lands plus Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Rakdos Signet, three Talismans, Mox Opal and Cursed Mirror, plus Treasure makers and four cost reducers.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Ashad needs a power-2+ creature to sacrifice. +1/-1 lifts 1-power bodies with toughness 2+ (Etherium Sculptor, Emry, Urza, Padeem, Pitiless Plunderer) to power 2 so they can pay casualty, and the equipped creature's death, including as the casualty payment, draws two. On 1-toughness bodies (Disciple, Goblin Welder, Baleful Strix, Construct/Servo-style tokens) it kills them for two cards instead. It is a 1-mana nonlegendary artifact, so a casualty copy makes a second Clamp.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Equip is sorcery speed. It does nothing without creatures, and artifact removal/Vandalblast hits it. It is a tutor target for opponents' artifact hate.
material_candidates.reason: The cheapest repeatable card-draw engine in colorless, and it directly widens which bodies can pay casualty 2. Fellwar Stone is the weakest of nine rocks.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Ashad High Lift; live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: Two-mana 3/2 artifact fodder that refunds a Treasure on death
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Reckless Fireweaver's 1 damage to each opponent per artifact entering. Ingenious Artillerist, Mayhem Devil and Disciple keep the ping/drain role.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: A 3-power body for {1}{R} is ideal casualty fodder. When sacrificed it leaves a Treasure, so the copy partly pays for itself. The Treasure is an artifact entering (Artillerist), a sacrifice (Mayhem Devil), and with Pitiless Plunderer the death gives a second Treasure. It is a nonlegendary artifact spell for Jhoira, Uthros Research Craft, Poetic Ingenuity and Biotransference.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Can't do anything alone, and a 3/2 dies to every sweeper. Fireweaver's damage would have been more reach in a long KCI turn.
material_candidates.reason: Same mana cost as Fireweaver, but Fireweaver is a 1/3 that can't pay casualty; Piggy Bank pays casualty and refunds mana.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Ashad page; live Scryfall Oracle; Commander Spellbook 4050-4871-6429
material_candidates.role: Two-mana 3/1 artifact fodder that returns from the graveyard at instant speed
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Thoughtcast (affinity draw two, usually 1-2 mana). Skullclamp, Jhoira, Uthros Research Craft, Thought Monitor, Ichor Wellspring, Mystic Forge and Padeem stay as draw.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Fodder that recurs: {4}{B}{B} returns it with a +1/+1 counter, and the ability costs {4} less when an opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands (normal at this power level), so {B}{B}. It is an activated ability with no timing restriction, so the body comes back for the next turn's or an opponent-turn (Shimmer Myr) casualty. With Pitiless Plunderer + Phyrexian Altar, both already in the deck, Spellbook lists an infinite loop (4050-4871-6429) when the discount applies. Disciple of the Vault and Mayhem Devil turn that loop into a win, and each sacrifice adds a counter to Ashad.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: The discount depends on opponents' land bases. Graveyard exile stops the recursion, it can't block, and the loop needs three pieces plus a payoff. That makes the deck's combo density higher, which must be disclosed for Bracket talk (still not a two-card combo).
material_candidates.reason: Repeatable fodder at two mana, plus a disclosed three-card conditional loop made from incumbents. Thoughtcast is the least commander-relevant draw spell.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Ashad page; live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: Flash 5/3 artifact creature: ETB destroy up to one target creature, target player mills three
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Marionette Master, a 6-mana nonartifact creature (Ashad can't copy it without Biotransference). Fabricate 3 gives either 1/1 Servos (can't pay casualty) or a 4/6 body. Its drain equal to its power whenever an artifact dies is a real KCI/Treasure payoff and is the largest loss in the package.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Flash makes it the first nonlegendary artifact spell on an opponent's turn without Shimmer Myr: casualty 2 copies it, so it kills two creatures at instant speed and leaves two power-5 bodies that are themselves fodder. Milling yourself feeds Emry, Goblin Welder, Scrap Trawler and Academy Ruins.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Five mana. 'Up to one' creature, so no planeswalker or artifact answer beyond creatures. The milled player choice can't hit a combo piece in hand.
material_candidates.reason: Adds instant-speed, copyable removal that is also fodder. Marionette Master is the most expensive non-artifact payoff the commander can't amplify.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Ashad High Lift (top lift); live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: Five-mana artifact Necron that makes two tapped 2/2 artifact Necron tokens; unearth {3}{B}
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Thopter Spy Network, a 4-mana enchantment (not an artifact spell) that makes one 1/1 Thopter per upkeep (too small for casualty 2) and draws when artifacts connect. It also loses the Thopter + Skullclamp draw synergy.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Three bodies of power 2+ in one card. A casualty copy is a second Warden: six bodies. Unearth brings it back for another two tokens. Tapped tokens can still be sacrificed. Feeds Ashad counters, Pitiless Plunderer, Esoteric Duplicator (artifact creatures), Mayhem Devil and Disciple.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Five mana, with sorcery-speed unearth. If the unearthed Warden is sacrificed it is exiled, so it doesn't die for Plunderer, but the sacrifice still counts for Ashad. Tokens are exposed to sweepers.
material_candidates.reason: The best fodder factory for a commander that eats a body every turn. Thopter Spy Network's 1/1s don't pay casualty 2 (Pass C already flagged Spy Network as a possible cut).

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Ashad page (top creature); live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: Two-mana 2/2 artifact Cyberman; artifact creatures get afflict 3
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would lose Ichor Wellspring, which draws when it enters and when it dies, can be a sacrifice for KCI or Esoteric Duplicator, and was selected in the 2026-10-13 closeout over Dalek Drone.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Cheap power-2 Cyberman fodder (flavor match) and afflict damage from Warden tokens and copies.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: A 2/2 with no card advantage. Wellspring's copy is two cards on entry and two on death.
material_candidates.reason: After the five adds, fodder is already 17->21 cards plus Warden tokens. Wellspring's card flow is the better marginal slot. Staged as a six-swap alternative.

material_candidates.source: OFF-RANKING search (not on the Ashad EDHREC page); live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: Four-mana 3/3 artifact; when it dies, cascade-style free spell (MV 3 or less)
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would lose Auton Soldier, the 6-mana Doctor Who clone with myriad that copies the best creature on any board and is copyable by Ashad.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Perfect casualty fodder: sacrificing it gives a free spell, so the copy turn becomes a three-for-one. A copy of Keeper is a second free spell later.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: The free spell is random (could be a rock). It is worse than Auton Soldier's ceiling copying Wurmcoil/Gearhulk/an opposing bomb, and it cuts a Doctor Who identity card.
material_candidates.reason: Lowers the curve and adds fodder, but Auton Soldier's ceiling and identity are worth the six mana. Staged as a six-swap alternative.

material_candidates.source: Pass C comparator (Artificer Class); EDHREC; live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: Spree instant: counter, copy an artifact/creature, loot
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would lose Artificer Class, the Spellbook combo piece (66-457-5491 with Urza + Worldwalker Helm) and the repeatable first-artifact discount.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Copy mode creates an artifact token (Helm Map replacement applies) without fodder. Counter mode protects the engine.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Five one-for-one swaps that turn three low-impact incumbents (Fellwar Stone, Reckless Fireweaver, Thoughtcast) into Skullclamp, Piggy Bank and Razorlash Transmogrant, and two non-artifact engines the commander can't copy (Marionette Master, Thopter Spy Network) into copyable artifact fodder and removal (Royal Warden, Necron Deathmark). Costs: one fewer rock (39->38 static sources), no Fireweaver pings, no Marionette drain, no Spy Network card draw, more black pips. Gains: casualty-eligible creatures 17->21 cards plus two Warden tokens, nonlegendary artifacts 37->41, repeatable Skullclamp draw, instant-speed copyable removal, and a disclosed three-card conditional loop from incumbents.

low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The commander copies one artifact spell per turn only if a power-2+ creature is already on board, yet ten creatures and the Spy Network tokens have power 1, and nine rocks plus a sorcery draw spell occupy slots that could be bodies.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Trade the ninth rock, a 1/3 pinger, a sorcery draw spell and two engines Ashad can't copy for four casualty-eligible artifacts (one recursive, one a token factory, one instant removal) plus Skullclamp.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Exact copy of the canonical source order with five in-place substitutions; 30 lands, 8 rocks, 100 physical cards verified by quantity (95 rows; Island x3, Mountain x2, Swamp x3).

owner_authority.owner_approval_question: This deck is complete. Do you approve it?

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After the five swaps, every remaining incumbent was re-read against the commander. Mana: 30 lands + 8 rocks is the floor; no further rock or land cut. Draw: Ichor Wellspring, Thought Monitor, Jhoira, Uthros Research Craft, Mystic Forge and Padeem stay. Top end: Auton Soldier, Cybermen Squadron, Portal, Wurmcoil, Gearhulk, Cyberdrive Awakener and Kappa are copy targets worth the mana. Utility 1-power creatures (Emry, Welder, Urza, Plunderer, Disciple) are engines or combo pieces, not fodder slots.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Patrol is a 2-mana Cyberman body for casualty; Wellspring is two cards per copy and a KCI/Duplicator sacrifice. With fodder already 17->21, card flow wins. Staged six-swap.
Keeper is cheaper fodder that pays out a free spell; Auton's copyable clone has a higher ceiling and is Doctor Who identity. Kept Auton; staged six-swap.
Three Steps is flexible but never uses casualty; Class is a complete Spellbook combo piece and a repeatable discount. Kept Class.
Missy turns sweepers into fodder but is legendary (uncopyable) and is its own encyclopedia commander; Squadron is the copyable finisher. Kept Squadron.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: A sixth cheap power-2 Cyberman body maximizes turn-two/three casualty readiness and adds afflict pressure from tokens.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Wellspring's copy draws two on entry and two on death and feeds KCI/Esoteric Duplicator; after the five adds, more fodder has lower marginal value than card flow.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Treasure Keeper lowers the curve and turns each casualty payment into a free spell, an off-ranked find.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Auton Soldier copies the best creature on any board, is copyable by Ashad, and is a Doctor Who identity card; Keeper's free spell is random and often a rock.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Maximum-fodder seven-swap: 23 casualty-eligible cards and a lower curve.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: It combines both rejected trades: it loses Wellspring's card flow and Auton's ceiling and identity for marginal extra bodies the deck no longer lacks.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stopped at five because the remaining weak-looking slots (Wellspring, Auton Soldier, Class, Squadron, Cursed Mirror, Sculptor, Orchard, Disciple) each have a named, concrete role a challenger loses: card flow, ceiling, a combo piece, the finisher, mana floor, early discount or loop payoff. No sixth trade was a clear upgrade on quality, not count.
